meta.title: Toolchain
meta.description: Adds a Toolchain page to Settings between Models and Plugins. Installed npm/pip dependencies are listed one per row with a Delete button; below them a one-tap install grid covers the common packages (pnpm, typescript, tsx, eslint, prettier, vite, requests, numpy, pandas, beautifulsoup4 and more) so nothing has to be typed, and installed ones are marked. It also cleans the cache/downloads/build/tmp folders behind a confirmation, shows the installed toolchains and the last command's output.
